benchmark_metadata.name: Synthetic RAG Evaluation Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.description: Deterministic benchmark for measuring retrieval Recall@k, Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), and unanswerable question abstention accuracy across synthetic PDF, Markdown, and text documents.

questions.question: What base temperature do dilution refrigerators maintain for superconducting quantum processors?
questions.expected_answer: Superconducting quantum processors operate inside dilution refrigerators at approximately 10 to 15 millikelvin (-273.14 degrees Celsius).
questions.notes: Single passage retrieval from Section 3 of quantum computing document.

questions.question: What conversion efficiency range do monocrystalline silicon solar cells achieve?
questions.expected_answer: Monocrystalline silicon cells achieve commercial laboratory conversion efficiencies between 20.0% and 24.5%.
questions.notes: Single passage retrieval from Section 1 of photovoltaic systems document.

questions.question: What are the three operational states of a node in a Raft consensus cluster?
questions.expected_answer: Nodes in a Raft cluster exist in one of three states: Follower, Candidate, or Leader.

questions.question: How do monocrystalline and polycrystalline solar cells compare in efficiency and temperature coefficient?
questions.expected_answer: Monocrystalline cells have 20.0%-24.5% efficiency and a temperature coefficient between -0.30%/°C and -0.38%/°C, while polycrystalline cells have 15.0%-18.5% efficiency and a higher negative temperature coefficient between -0.39%/°C and -0.45%/°C.
questions.notes: Cross-passage question requiring Sections 1 and 2 of photovoltaic systems document.

questions.question: What is the difference between T1 relaxation time and T2 dephasing time in qubits?
questions.expected_answer: T1 is the longitudinal energy relaxation duration for an excited state to decay to ground state, while T2 is the transverse phase coherence duration over which relative phase information is corrupted.

questions.question: What timer range triggers leader election in Raft, and how is split-brain prevented?
questions.expected_answer: Randomized election timeouts range from 150 to 300 milliseconds. Split-brain is prevented because electing a leader requires a strict quorum majority overlapping with the previous log commit quorum.
questions.notes: Cross-passage question spanning Pages 2 and 3 of distributed consensus PDF.

questions.question: What are the three power inverter topologies used in photovoltaic systems?
questions.expected_answer: The three inverter topologies are Central Inverters, String Inverters, and Microinverters.
